notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40318654/443c9222685ad9470d19a79f19235d9025eadeda.png[/img]

[b]Let's create a cute and curious game!
Hello, this is CatDoors.[/b]

The 1.0.172 update includes modifications to game rating labeling and convenience features in Korea.

Please refer to the details below for more information.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[b][Black Academy - 1.0.172 Update][/b]


[h3]■ Additions and modifications[/h3]

[b]1. Revision of Korean Game Rating Labeling[/b]
• According to the regulations of the Korean Game Rating Board, the rating label has been revised as follows.
• Restricted to Youth (18+) → Restricted to Youth (19+)

[b]2. Minimap Warp Improvement[/b]
• The minimap has been updated to allow selection through the Focus UI, even across areas without paths.

[b]3. Background Scroll Speed Adjustment[/b]
• Since the speed of enemy bullets varies with difficulty, there were instances where the background scrolled faster than the bullets.
• The background scroll speed has been adjusted for each difficulty level so that it is slower than the bullets.

[b]4. Add Notification Popup[/b]
An additional notification popup has been added to prompt for confirmation when selecting 'Restart' or 'Main Menu' on the settings screen for added safety.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

I hope you enjoy the game more with this patch.

Thank you!

notes.title: Black Academy 1.0.171 Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40318654/443c9222685ad9470d19a79f19235d9025eadeda.png[/img]

[b]Let's create a cute and curious game!
Hello, this is CatDoors.[/b]

This 1.0.171 update focuses on enhancing the gameplay experience of Black Academy by adding features primarily related to game balance and adjusting various parameters.


Please refer to the details below for more information.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[b][Black Academy - 1.0.171 Update][/b]


[h3]■ Additions and modifications[/h3]

[b]1. Reduction in the number of rooms (barriers)[/b]
• To prevent excessively long playtimes resulting from exploring every area, we have reduced the number of rooms (barriers) to alleviate boredom.
• Meet bosses more quickly and enjoy thrilling battles!

[b]2. Jamu Jamu, Reward Revamp[/b]
• The probability of acquiring experience from Jamu Jamu has increased. (30% -> 50%)
• As your level increases, the amount of experience obtained from Jamu Jamu also increases.

[b]3. Additional Rewards for Mid-Bosses[/b]
• Although defeating mid-bosses already yields a substantial amount of experience, additional rewards are provided as it was deemed insufficient.
• Additional Reward: Magical Items (Rare grade or higher) *Legendary grade may also appear.

[b]4. Crunch Mode, Increased Rewards[/b]
• Experience Drop Rate (50% → 100%)
• Coin Acquisition Amount (50% → 100%)

[b]5. Leviah, Increase in Attack Power[/b]
• Leviah's attack power has been adjusted upward to allow for more effectiveness in battles.
(30% increase)

[b]6. Charging Attack Enhancement[/b]
• Charging attacks now become progressively stronger based on current attack power and level.
• Additionally, they gain additional effects based on the Magical Power rank.
(Values for each rank do not accumulate.)

[Rina]
• Level 2: Bullet size (1.5x), Charge attack damage (+10%)
• Level 3: Bullet size (2x), Charge attack damage (+30%)

[Levia]
• Level 2: Tutu duration (+0.2 seconds), Charge attack damage (+5%)
• Level 3: Tutu duration (+0.5 seconds), Charge attack damage (+10%)

[b]7. Boss, HP Increase[/b]
• As the barrier diminishes, and Levia's attack power and charged attacks increase, the boss's HP increases.
• Boss HP Increase (+30%)

[b]8. Magical Stone, Additional Acquisition Source[/b]
• Upon achieving 1000 points, you will be able to acquire an additional Magical Stone.


[h3]■ Issue fixed[/h3]

[b]1. Sound Effect Muting Issue[/b]
• Correction of the issue where sound disappears as more sound effects are played.

[b]2. Honey Bee Box Appearance Issue[/b]
• Correction of the issue where honey bee boxes were not appearing frequently.

[b]3. Suspicious Witch Appearance Issue[/b]
• If the player has already reached level 3, the suspicious witch will not appear.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

I hope you enjoy the game more with this patch.

Thank you!

notes.title: CG Additional Censorship Announcement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40318654/443c9222685ad9470d19a79f19235d9025eadeda.png[/img]

[b]Let's create a cute and curious game!
Hello, this is CatDoors.[/b]

First of all, we sincerely apologize for the unfortunate news.

With the official release of Black Academy, the level of illustration exposure has been updated.

Based on our goal to develop the game with the highest level of exposure in Korea, we created illustrations and went through the update rating review process.

However, we have received feedback from the Game Rating Committee stating that "the illustrations are excessively provocative."

Therefore, we have been requested to revert the illustrations with increased exposure back to the Early Access version, and we plan to proceed with the update.

(The related update is scheduled to take place on June 16, 2023.)

However, through future reevaluation, we will update the illustrations to be as appealing as possible.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40318654/443c9222685ad9470d19a79f19235d9025eadeda.png[/img]

[b]Let's create a cute and curious game!
Hello, this is CatDoors.[/b]


In version 1.0.167, issues have been resolved and usability has been improved. Supporters' nicknames have been added to the ending credits. Please refer to the details below for more information.


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[b][Black Academy - 1.0.167 Update][/b]


[h3]■ Additional Content[/h3]

[b]1. Steam Cloud, Achievements[/b]
• Steam Cloud, Achievement feature has been added.

[b]2. Magical Spell_Rank-based Effects[/b]
• Through the appearance effects, you can feel the anticipation of what magical spell will appear.

[b]3. Added Boss (Stage 2 - Rico) effects[/b]
• Added effects to the 1st phase, 2nd pattern.

[b]4. Boss (Stage 5_Panya) 4th Phase UI Added[/b]
• An instructional UI has been added to the 4th phase, similar to other phases.

[b]5. Added Ending Credits Content[/b]
• The nicknames of Tumblbug supporters have been added.
• The nickname of the player who first cleared the Black difficulty has been added.
(Verification video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3GUAwCF10Rs)

[b]6. Blacklist_ Buff Effects[/b]
• The buff effects applied through the Blacklist are also displayed in the 'ID Card - Buff Effects'.

[b]7. Added Main Screen Button Controls (Considered UX)[/b]
• You can now execute the selection function on the main screen by pressing the [Enter] button.
• You can now close the conversation log by pressing the [ESC] button.

[b]8. Tutorial: Magical Spell Destruction[/b]
• Additional dialogue for Magical Spell Destruction has been added.


[h3]■ Issue Fixes[/h3]

[b]1. Magical Spell Effect Skip - Active Spell[/b]
• When you have an active spell, skipping the magical spell acquisition effect will no longer result in the active spell being used.

[b]2. Black List - Panya (List 1 - A weekend date?)[/b]
• The values have been adjusted according to the original design intention. (When upgraded up to level 10, it will increase by 1 level.)
• The issue where the magic item selection UI did not appear when leveling up due to the Blacklist effect has been resolved.

[b]3. Mid-Boss - Conversion of Bullets into Coins[/b]
• When defeating the mid-boss, enemy bullets are now converted into coins.

[b]4. Wandering Merchant, Raccoon [Deuki] - Refresh[/b]
• Refreshing is not available when all items in the shop have been purchased.

[b]5. Language selection popup[/b]
• Fixed the issue where the PV video was playing even when no language was selected.

[b]6. Magical Spell_Levia_Small Rocket, Guided shuriken[/b]
• The issue of occasionally failing to aim accurately at enemies has been fixed.

[b]7. 1st Stage_Print Devil (Charge Devil)_Hit effect[/b]
• When restarting the game, the intermittent hit effect where enemies turn red was not resetting properly, and this issue has been fixed.

[b]8. Jamu Jamu_Level Up[/b]
• The issue where the portal did not appear when leveling up consecutively has been fixed.

[b]9. Character Skin Illustration Replacement in Magical Compendium[/b]
• The issue where clicking the illustration replacement button with the mouse would result in the closing function instead of the replacement has been fixed.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Moving forward, there are plans to continue addressing issues, improving convenience, and adding small-scale content.
We will continue to make efforts to make the game even more enjoyable in the future.

Thank you!

notes.title: Black Academy Official Release!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40318654/443c9222685ad9470d19a79f19235d9025eadeda.png[/img]

Let's create a game full of cuteness and curiosity!
Hello, we are CatDoors!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40318654/f7e35956ab712bbd8df727472704a322eb343204.png[/img]

[b]On May 26, 2023 at 6:30 PM, Black Academy was officially released![/b]

The major update in the official release version 1.0.164 includes the addition of stages 4 and 5, along with enhanced illustrations.

For more details, please refer to the information provided below.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[Black Academy - Update 1.0.164]

[h3]■ Stage Addition[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40318654/6cf29c1e259795eee9f26023bceaa20252492ce9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40318654/3c82aa8553e4f815d7d938328d5e26d235f646ce.png[/img]

• Additional stages 4 and 5, featuring new demons, have been added to Black Academy.
• Break free from the interference of demons and make your way towards a peaceful commute back home!


[h3]■ Increased illustration exposure[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40318654/67b606540055356a825062dbe31bc451d96c6c02.png[/img]

During the early access period, there were many opinions stating that the illustrations were less explicit compared to the adult rating.
In the official release version, we have updated to provide you with increased exposure illustrations to enjoy.

• An illustration is displayed as each phase progresses, and the exposure gradually increases.
• When the phase is short, low-exposure illustrations are excluded and not displayed.


[h3]■ Language Addition (Japanese)[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40318654/c44d3f33ace6a95289d6375813d4283c522809f5.png[/img]

• Japanese language has been added.
• The text of difficulty selection and game over images has been localized for each language.


[h3]■ Additional & Modifications[/h3]
1. Magic Items

1.1. Multi-use hook
• The effectiveness of coin acquisition range has been deemed low, so the item abilities have been modified.
• Increase in coin acquisition range → Increase in attack power and movement speed.

1.2. Buttering up
• As the stages progress, the efficiency of coin consumption reduction has become excessively favorable.
• The stats of rare grade items have been adjusted.
• (Rare Grade) Coin Consumption Rate Decreased: 20% → 15%

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Finally, Black Academy has been officially released!
There are still many contents that we want to improve and add.

We will continue to develop it to make it a better game.
We sincerely appreciate the support and encouragement from everyone!

notes.title: Black Academy EARLY ACCESS 0.1.163 Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40318654/443c9222685ad9470d19a79f19235d9025eadeda.png[/img]

[b]Let's create a cute and curious game!
Hello, this is CatDoors.[/b]

In the Early Access version 0.1.163, difficulty selection and refresh (reroll) have been added,
and a new NPC, the "Mysterious Witch," has appeared at the Black Academy.

In addition, various items have been updated, so please check the details below for more information.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[b][BLACK ACADEMY EARLY ACCESS - 0.1.163 UPDATE][/b]

[h3]■ Difficulty Selection[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40318654/1c8d0ba1eb72d4c9d15b64f27056b5ab759447ec.png[/img]
• Difficulty selection feature has been added to allow players to play the game based on their skill level.
• When clicking the [Start Overtime] button on the main screen, a screen to select the difficulty level will appear.
• There are a total of four difficulty levels, and the characteristics of each level are as follows:

[table] [tr] [th]Difficulty[/th] [th]Max Hearts[/th] [th]Boss Phase[/th] [/tr] [tr] [td]Easy[/td] [td]5[/td] [td]1[/td] [/tr] [tr] [td]Normal[/td] [td]4[/td] [td]2[/td] [/tr] [tr] [td]Hard[/td] [td]3[/td] [td]3[/td] [/tr] [tr] [td]Black[/td] [td]3[/td] [td]3[/td] [/tr] [/table]
(Some patterns of the Black difficulty boss use more powerful attacks.)


[h3]■ NPC Addition (Mysterious Witch)[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40318654/81e227f480b591831d93e53b0c98430589c89c35.png[/img]
• Previously, in order to acquire the Magic Orb and perform the Magic Power Up, players had to defeat a demon holding the Magic Orb. However, it was deemed to detract from the fun of growth due to the low demands compared to the increase in ability.
• Therefore, we have removed the "Demon holding the Magic Orb".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40318654/888a2a7548401a2bd9227f65813c9ec6edf0b4cb.png[/img]
• From now on, however, players can acquire the Magic Orb through the "Mysterious Witch".
• Players can purchase the Magic Orb with coins, and the purchase price is divided by each Power Up level.

[table] [tr] [th]Power Up Level[/th] [th]1 → 2[/th] [th]2 → 3[/th] [/tr] [tr] [td]Required Coins[/td] [td]500[/td] [td]1,000[/td] [/tr] [/table]


[h3]■ Refresh (Magical Spells, Magic Items, Raccoon Shop)[/h3]

• If the desired item does not appear, you can use the refresh feature to exchange it for another item.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40318654/ad17c372e73557b6253c381ddb2916daa9806f43.png[/img]
• 'Magical Spells' and 'Magic Items' have different required coin amounts depending on the grade, and only items that are higher than the grade being refreshed appear.

[table] [tr] [th]Grade[/th] [th]Common[/th] [th]Rare[/th] [th]Legendary[/th] [/tr] [tr] [td]Required Coins[/td] [td]100[/td] [td]300[/td] [td]800[/td] [/tr] [/table]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40318654/161558cd7202015fbf5fbf4fece8dffca8d054be.png[/img]
• The required coin amount for the 'Raccoon Shop' is fixed at 500, and all items appear randomly.


[h3]■ Magical Spell[/h3]

Normal Grade
• To enhance the fun of shooting attacks, the normal grade spell has been adjusted as follows:
• Attack speed is increased by 25%.
• Attack power is decreased by 20%.

Leviah Magical Spell
• The attack power of Leviah's magical spell has been adjusted to help her in combat.

The attack power of Leviah's magical spell is increased by 20%.
Nya Nya Punch
• As it showed a higher attack efficiency than intended, its attack power has been adjusted.
Attack power is decreased by 30%.


[h3]■ Additions and Changes[/h3]

1. Magical Box Open Skip
• A skip feature has been added for the magic circle animation that appears when opening a Magical Spell box.

2. Bee Box and Honey Waffle
2.1. Appearance probability adjustment
• The appearance probability of Bee Boxes and Honey Waffles has been adjusted as they were appearing more frequently than intended.
• Bee Box: 30% → 10%
• Honey Waffle: 15% → 10%

2.2. Adjustment of number of Magical Spells (legendary) in Bee Box
• The number of Magical Spells of each grade appearing in Bee Boxes has been adjusted.
• Legendary grade: 3 → 1
• Rare grade: 0 → 2

3. Demon HP adjustment
• The HP of some demons has been adjusted as they were being defeated before fully demonstrating their patterns.
3.1. Stapler Demon
• HP increased by 40%.

3.2. Baseball Demon
• HP increased by 50%.

4. Hana_Pattern_Prelude Animation
• When the Eye of Surveillance laser attack is imminent, the blink speed of the red guide UI increases.
• There is a slight delay before Word Tanha's attack is launched while she is wandering around Hana.

5. Gallery_Streamer Mode_CG Unlock Condition Modification
• CGs will now be unlocked regardless of the Streamer Mode (ON/OFF) status when discovered.

6. Debuff status notification animation
• A blue border effect gradually blinks at the edge of the screen to clearly indicate a debuff status.

7. Charging Attack_HP UI Shake Effect
• When dealing damage to a mid-boss or boss with a charging attack, the HP UI shakes.

8. BoBo the Owl Mission
• Demons will now disappear when the remaining time reaches 0 seconds.


[h3]■ Issue Fixes[/h3]

Fix for infinite loading issue on European OS language setting
• Fixed the issue where the loading screen would not progress when the OS language setting was set to a European language.

Boss defeat related issues
• Fixed the issue where players could continue attacking the boss even after their HP reached 0.
• Fixed the issue where the game would not progress to the next phase after the boss's HP reached 0.

Missing magic items (Max Heart, Max Magic Boom)
• Fixed the issue where magic items related to Max Heart and Max Magic Boom were not appearing.

Duplicate event tutorial display issue
• Fixed the intermittent issue where the event tutorial would be displayed twice.

Bubble Tea Devil not attacking issue
• Fixed the intermittent issue where the Bubble Tea Devil in Stage 2 would not attack.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

We have updated the game with the difficulty selection, refresh (reroll), and skip functions that many of you have provided feedback on. It feels fulfilling to finally add these systems that we have been wanting to include for a long time.

We are continuing to work hard towards our goal of an official release at the end of May, so please continue to show your support and interest.

Thank you!

notes.title: Demo version 0.0.149 update
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40318654/bb7986ba71507b1e5812bfd3b4ff73962625de38.png[/img]


[h2][b][Updates][/b][/h2]

1. Magical Collection
- [Magical Collection] has been added, where you can check the Magical Stars you have discovered while exploring the barriers of demons.

2. Enemy warning UI from behind
- A warning UI has been added to prevent the sudden movement of the enemy coming from behind.

3. Main screen keyboard operation
- The buttons on the main screen, which could only be operated with the mouse, have been changed so that the keyboard can also be operated.
-- Focusing movement: arrow keys
-- Decision: Z or Space

* Keyboard operation on the play screen will also be updated later.



[h2][b][Fix][/b][/h2]

1. Magical Exp
- The Magical EXP, which was set for each Magical Star, has been consolidated into one.
(This is to make it feel like a character experience, not a magical star.)

2. Magical Star Selection UI
- Magical star selection direction and UI have been modified.

3. Play Sceen - Magical Star and Experience UI
- UI has been modified to match the integration of Magical EXP into one.
- Clearly differentiated the currently used Magical Star from those that are not.
 
4. ESC - ID Card popup ui
- Added UI to check Magical Star (Active).
- The UI where you can check character stats with the gauge UI has been deleted and a buff UI has been added.
(The UI will be modified first as buff-related functions will be added later.)



[h2][b][Bug Fix][/b][/h2]

1. Fixed an issue where, after restarting with a quick start, when acquiring a Magical Star small rockets, it would not fire.

2. Fixed an issue where the stapler would be knocked back when hitting a stapler demon with Magical Star magic injection.

3. Fixed an issue that the Magical Star discarded from the previous game appears when restarting the game.

4. Fixed an issue that Magical Stars can be purchased from [Wandering Merchant [Deuki]] even though there are not enough Magical Coins.

notes.title: Demo version 0.0.148 update
notes.content:
[h2][b][Update][/b][/h2]

1. When the magic level experience is reduced, the experience points (dream fragments) are scattered around it.

2. Added Magical Star Discard function.
- If the Magical Star slot is full, you can use the [Discard Magical Star] function.
- This function discards the Magical Star of the Magical Slot currently in use.
- Press and hold the [X] button on the keyboard for 2 seconds to discard it.

3. Added Magical Star destruction function.
- The [Destruction] function has been added to the interaction with the abandoned Magical Star.
- Upon destruction, you can acquire [Dream Fragment] necessary to increase the magical level according to the grade of the Magical Star.
-- Normal: 10
-- Rare: 20
-- Legendary: 30

4. Added dialogue skip function.
- [Skip], a function that allows you to quickly skip lines, has been added.



[h2][b][Fix][/b][/h2]
1. If the currently used slot is full of experience points, it is modified to accumulate experience points in other slots.
- If the other slots are also full of experience points, it will be converted to +10 points per EXP.

2. Modified to enable attack in non-combat stage.
- The Magical Boom (bomb) cannot be used because there is room for unnecessary use.

3. Improved readability by changing the icon color displayed on the Magical Slot UI to white.



[h2][b][Bug Fix][/b][/h2]
1. After acquiring a Magical Star (Active), when replacing it with another Magical Star (Active), the original Magical Star UI does not turn off.

2. Fixed an issue where the Magical Star in the Magical Slot was discarded when changing to another skill Magical Star (Active) after acquiring a Magical Star (Active).

3. Fixed the phenomenon that the [PPT Scatter] pattern of one boss takes damage even though the user character is invincible.

4. Adjusted to fit the text of the speech bubble size of NPC wandering merchant raccoon dog [Deuki], clever fox [Coco], and cowardly owl [Bobo].

5. Fixed the phenomenon that when the Magical Star level is demoted, the EXP in the Magical Star 2 slot becomes 0.

6. Fixed the phenomenon that the animation of demons (monsters) was slow when restarting the game by pressing [ESC].

7. Fixed the issue where the bullet sound did not sound even when one boss was damaged.

8. Fixed the phenomenon that the boss pattern does not disappear even after clearing the boss.

9. When using Magical Star [Electron Storm], the image of Magical Star [Magic Injection] is broken.

10. If you delete some of the 5 word patterns (5 bullets coming out and shooting while spinning) with [Electron Storm], the speed of the remaining bullets is very fast fixed.

11. Fixed a bug where the minimap UI was not visible when moving to another cleared room immediately after clearing a room.
